name: query_msigdb
description: Check membership of genes in MSigDB gene sets with Jaccard similarity scoring (requires data lake volume mounted)
usage: from app.tools.biomni.data_lake import query_msigdb; result = query_msigdb(['TP53', 'MDM2', 'CDKN1A', 'BAX'], collection='H')

parameters.gene_list: list — list of gene symbols to check against gene sets

returns: dict with keys: collection, n_genes_input, n_gene_sets_matched, top_matches (list of {gene_set, matched_genes, n_matched, jaccard_similarity}), source
